meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或理解他人提交的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or understand the impact of others' commits

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析代码变更（git diff），结合项目知识图谱，告诉你哪些文件改了、哪些组件受影响、风险多高，并生成可视化数据。
howto.when: 当你需要理解代码变更的影响时，比如审查 pull request 或查看未提交的修改。

say.text: 分析当前分支的未提交变更，告诉我影响范围。
say.note: Claude 会执行 git diff 并查询知识图谱。

say.text: 帮我审查这个 PR #42 的改动，评估风险。
say.note: Claude 会获取 PR 的 diff 并分析。

say.text: 对比 main 分支，看看我改了哪些文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes code changes (git diff) against a project knowledge graph, identifying changed files, affected components, risks, and writes a diff overlay for visualization.
howto.when_en: When you need to understand the impact of code changes, such as reviewing a pull request or examining uncommitted modifications.

say_en.text: Analyze uncommitted changes on the current branch and tell me the impact.
say_en.note: Claude will run git diff and query the knowledge graph.

say_en.text: Review the changes in PR #42 and assess the risk.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the PR diff and analyze.

say_en.text: Compare with main branch to see what files I changed.
say_en.note: Claude will run git diff main...HEAD.
